hooks.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}") && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2]); import store; store.STORE_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True); (store.STORE_DIR/'.current_repo').write_text(sys.argv[1]); print(json.dumps(store.get_session_start_context(sys.argv[1])))" "$REPO" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
echo '{"systemMessage": "Contexer: context compaction starting — call update_context for any decisions not yet stored"}'

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}") && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2]); import store; data=store._load(sys.argv[1]); entries=data.get('entries',[]); decisions=[e for e in entries if e['type']=='decision']; msg=f'Contexer: {len(decisions)} decision(s) available — run get_context to reload' if decisions else 'Contexer: no context stored'; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':msg}))" "$REPO" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "Reminder: if you make a significant decision, establish a pattern, or document a constraint this turn, call update_context."}}'
